teaser: Four of the ten most valuable companies are graph companies. Graphs never scaled for everyone else because they were built to lock in. Now they can.
core_idea: Many of the most valuable companies are, at heart, graphs of links, people, products, payments and ontologies, and graphs make answers obvious once the right connections exist; they did not scale for everyone else because they were costly and built to lock customers in, without shared schemas or code, which fractal semantic graphs and agents can now change.
